FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker (other limit > 0)
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ticker
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE other_limit > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($product) OR left(ticker, 3) IN ($product))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Instruments (latest day in range)
panels.description: Counts rows in the B3 Daily Liquidity Limit - Other Limits file (LLDAdicional.txt, daily_parse parquet) for the latest trading day in the selected range only: total instruments, distinct products, and instruments with other_limit > 0. Filtered by the product (first 3 letters of ticker) and ticker variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($product) OR left(ticker, 3) IN ($product))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
)
SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments,
  count(DISTINCT left(ticker, 3))::BIGINT AS products,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE other_limit > 0)::BIGINT AS with_other_limit
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Instruments per day by product (top 12)
panels.description: Number of instruments listed in the LLDAdicional.txt file (daily_parse parquet) per trading day, stacked by product (first 3 letters of ticker). Only the 12 products with the most rows in the range are shown individually; the rest are grouped as 'others'. Filtered by the product and ticker variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, left(ticker, 3) AS product
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($product) OR left(ticker, 3) IN ($product))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT product FROM d GROUP BY product ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 12
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  CASE WHEN product IN (SELECT product FROM top_products) THEN product ELSE 'others' END AS product,
  count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
FROM d
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, product

panels.title: Other limit per contract
panels.description: Daily other_limit value per ticker from the LLDAdicional.txt file (daily_parse parquet), drawn as a step line. Only tickers with other_limit > 0 on at least one day in the range are plotted (mainly DDI futures); B3 does not document what this column means. Filtered by the product (first 3 letters of ticker) and ticker variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($product) OR left(ticker, 3) IN ($product))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM d
WHERE ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM d WHERE other_limit > 0)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Non-zero limits vs previous day (latest day in range)
panels.description: Instruments on the latest trading day in the range with a non-zero liquidity_limit or other_limit (or a non-zero other_limit the day before), comparing other_limit with the previous trading day in the range, matched by instrument ID. Data from the LLDAdicional.txt file (daily_parse parquet); liquidity_limit is undocumented by B3 and has always been 0. Filtered by the product (first 3 letters of ticker) and ticker variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($product) OR left(ticker, 3) IN ($product))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT c.ticker,
  c.instrument_id,
  c.liquidity_limit::DOUBLE AS liquidity_limit,
  p.other_limit::DOUBLE AS prev_other_limit,
  c.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit,
  (c.other_limit - p.other_limit)::DOUBLE AS other_limit_change
FROM cur c
LEFT JOIN prv p ON c.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
WHERE c.other_limit > 0 OR c.liquidity_limit > 0 OR p.other_limit > 0
ORDER BY c.other_limit DESC, c.ticker

panels.title: Instruments added / removed vs previous day (latest day in range)
panels.description: Instruments (matched by instrument ID) that appear in the LLDAdicional.txt file (daily_parse parquet) on the latest trading day in the range but not the previous one (added), or vice versa (removed), with their other_limit. The table is empty if the range has only one trading day, and the list is capped at 2000 rows. Filtered by the product (first 3 letters of ticker) and ticker variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($product) OR left(ticker, 3) IN ($product))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT 'added' AS status, c.ticker, c.instrument_id, c.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM cur c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prv p WHERE p.instrument_id = c.instrument_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prv)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'removed' AS status, p.ticker, p.instrument_id, p.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM prv p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cur c WHERE c.instrument_id = p.instrument_id)
ORDER BY status, ticker
LIMIT 2000
